body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 4481c2a06e238ba15791cf4e2e8acc777503a273 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of stock simulation playback. The base now comes from the uncut stock. Later frames keep the same base and update the cut layer. The new test checks the packed lattice that the display uses.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2446`. The trial merge with upstream main `abe24ff09d789757399cfcdf5f43c53ad9f9cbfb` was clean. That commit is already an ancestor of this head. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build of the selected app test targets | Passed |
| App library tests | 362 passed; 1 ignored |
| `stock_play` | 7 passed |
| `stock_play_partial` | 3 passed |
| `stock_play_precalc` | 8 passed; 1 heavy test ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The compiler cache did not answer a version check within 30 seconds. I disabled the cache. The checks used `target/local-review` inside the review worktree.

I ran two mutation checks with temporary compiler inputs. I did not change the worktree source.

1. Pack the base after precalculation: the new test failed. Move 0 had 2,016 solid texels; it required 2,880.
2. Omit the packed base: the new test failed with `the worker packs its frames for the eye`.

After both mutations, the unchanged PR source passed the full `stock_play_precalc` suite again: 8 passed; 1 heavy test ignored.

Requested changes: none. No golden files changed. No files in `crates/ui` changed.

Limit: I did not run the windowed app or the GPU shader. The test checks the packed lattice. Code inspection confirms that the shader uses the same `max(mesh, cut)` composition.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
